card.name: Inside brand drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of capitalized brand names split into parts, such as NIKTIMVO, NICOTROL, MINOCIN and FOLLISTIM. It fires on the second piece, before the name finishes.

modes.label: Brand name in all caps
modes.description: The second piece of an uppercase brand name written in warnings or dosing text.
modes.example: A full bottle of NIC<<OT>>ROL NS contains 100 mg

modes.label: Brand name in infusion text
modes.description: The piece after the first letter of a brand name used in infusion instructions.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of N<<IK>>TIMVO is 0.3 mg

modes.label: Generic name mid-split
modes.description: A piece inside a mixed-case generic drug name.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a brand drug name that is still being spelled out.
